- **Ignores case, spaces, and punctuation** - "Race Car!" is considered a palindrome since it reads the same forwards/backwards when cleaned to "racecar"
- Uses two-pointer technique for efficient O(n) time complexity
- Handles edge cases (null, empty strings)
- Includes test examples in main()
